q4_head_basic.text: Since your script is in the head without defer/async, you need to wait for the DOM to load:

q4_head_defer.question: Place the notifyAppReady() call
q4_head_defer.text: Since your script has defer, the DOM is already ready when your script runs:
q4_head_defer.warning: You MUST put CapacitorUpdater.notifyAppReady(); before running any other code

q4_head_async.question: Place the notifyAppReady() call
q4_head_async.text: Since your script is async, you need to check if the DOM is ready:

q4_head_module.question: Place the notifyAppReady() call

q4_other_frameworks.question: Place the notifyAppReady() call
